tagline.en: From Changhua over the Bagua hills and up the Wu and Mei valleys through Puli to Wushe and the Lushan hot springs, the western half of a cross-island road that was never finished
tagline.zh: 自彰化越过八卦台地，沿乌溪、眉溪谷地经埔里上至雾社与庐山温泉，是一条始终未修通的横贯公路的西半段

start.en: Zhongzhuang, Changhua city, at Provincial Highway 1
start.zh: 彰化市中庄，衔接台 1 线

end.en: Tunyuan, Ren'ai, Nantou, beyond the Lushan hot springs, at the trailhead of the Nenggao trail
end.zh: 南投县仁爱乡屯原，庐山温泉以东，能高越岭道西段登山口

en: Provincial Highway 14 runs 99.021 km from Changhua city east over the Bagua tableland to Fenyuan and Caotun, then up the Wu river valley through Guoxing to Puli, which it shares with Highway 21 for about 2.8 km. From Puli it climbs the Mei river gorge to Wushe at 79 km, where Highway 14A leaves for Hehuanshan, and goes on to the Lushan hot springs at about 94 km and its end at Tunyuan.

Caotun to Puli is known as the Zhongtan Highway and Puli to Wushe as the Puwu Highway. Freeway 6 now runs parallel from Wufeng to Puli. Beyond Puli the road is the only way to Wushe, Lushan and, by Highway 14A, Qingjing and Hehuanshan. It has four spurs: 14A, 14B (18.290 km), 14C (2.882 km) and 14D (10.156 km).
zh: 台 14 线全长 99.021 公里，自彰化市向东越过八卦台地至芬园、草屯，再沿乌溪谷地经国姓至埔里，与台 21 线共线约 2.8 公里。自埔里沿眉溪峡谷上行，至 79 公里处的雾社，台 14 甲线由此分出前往合欢山；本线续行至约 94 公里的庐山温泉，终于屯原。
草屯至埔里段称中潭公路，埔里至雾社段称埔雾公路。国道 6 号如今自雾峰至埔里与之平行。埔里以东，本线是前往雾社、庐山，以及经台 14 甲线前往清境、合欢山的唯一道路。它有四条支线：台 14 甲、台 14 乙（18.290 公里）、台 14 丙（2.882 公里）与台 14 丁（10.156 公里）。

en: The road up the Mei gorge crosses old frontier ground. At Renzhiguan, about 74 km, a narrow gorge between the Daguan and Ren'ai bridges, the Qing barred Han settlers from going further; on 29 April 1902 Seediq villagers there drove back a Japanese garrison force from Puli. Wushe, at 1,148 m, became the centre of Japanese control of the area and was the scene of the Seediq uprising of 27 October 1930, the Wushe incident; the memorial park beside the road began in the early 1950s, when remains of the dead were found and reburied there.

The Japanese planned a central cross-island road from Lushan east to Tongmen in Hualien, but the Pacific War stopped it, and only Wushe to Lushan was built. Over the central range ran the Nenggao trail, a police road begun in 1917. In 1950–53 Taipower used it to carry the first east–west power line, with US$400,000 of American aid: a 75 km patrol road was finished in 1951, a wooden-pole line was sending power by November 1951, and a steel-tower line followed in 1953.

In the 1978 renumbering Highway 14 was planned through to Renshou in Ji'an, Hualien, taking in the Wushe–Tunyuan road and a Taipower road from Qilai to Renshou, while Wushe–Dayuling became 14A. The 45.4 km over the range, along the Nenggao trail, was never built. On 19 November 2009 an Executive Yuan announcement struck off Lushan–Renshou and renamed the route Changhua–Lushan, 99.021 km.
zh: 眉溪峡谷上行的道路穿越昔日的番界。约 74 公里处的人止关，是大观桥与仁爱桥之间的狭窄峡谷，清代在此禁止汉人入山；1902 年 4 月 29 日，赛德克族人在此击退自埔里出发的日军守备队，史称“人止关之役”。海拔 1,148 米的雾社成为日方控制该地区的中心，1930 年 10 月 27 日在此发生赛德克族起事，即雾社事件；路旁的纪念公园始于 1950 年代初，当时挖出起事者遗骸，合葬于此。
日方曾计划自庐山（富士社）向东至花莲铜门修筑中部横断道路，因太平洋战争停工，只完成雾社至庐山段。翻越中央山脉的是 1917 年开辟的能高越岭警备道。1950 年至 1953 年，台电利用这条古道架设第一条东西输电线，经费为美援 40 万美元：1951 年完成 75 公里巡线道路，同年 11 月木杆线路送电，1953 年钢塔线路完成。
1978 年省道改编时，台 14 线规划延伸至花莲吉安仁寿，纳入雾社至屯原道路及台电奇莱至仁寿道路，雾社至大禹岭段则改编为台 14 甲线。翻越中央山脉、沿能高越岭道的 45.4 公里始终未兴建。2009 年 11 月 19 日行政院公告，废止庐山至仁寿段，路线名称改为彰化－庐山，全长 99.021 公里。

en: The earthquake of 21 September 1999 broke the road. The Guoxing section subsided, rocks fell at the Ganlin tunnel, the Puwu Highway was cut and the Yanfeng bridge damaged; the Nantou routes were reopened by 29 September. The directorate's Second District office put its total earthquake repairs at NT$5.826 billion, of which NT$3.307 billion was emergency work.

Since then the works have been local. In 2019 a legislator announced NT$29 million for protection works at Renzhiguan. The Changshou bridge at 46 km in Guoxing was rebuilt for NT$419.85 million, lengthened from 240 m to 291 m; the old bridge closed on 15 November 2022 and the new one was due on 11 September 2023.
zh: 1999 年 9 月 21 日地震重创本线：国姓路段路基下陷，柑林隧道落石，埔雾公路中断，炎峰桥受损；南投各线于 9 月 29 日前抢通。公路总局第二区养护工程处统计，其辖区地震修复经费共 58.26 亿元，其中抢修 33.07 亿元。
此后的工程多属局部。2019 年，立法委员宣布争取 2,900 万元办理人止关防护工程。国姓 46 公里处的长寿桥改建，经费 4.1985 亿元，桥长由 240 米增至 291 米；旧桥于 2022 年 11 月 15 日封闭，新桥预定 2023 年 9 月 11 日完工。

en: Speed limits are 25 to 70 km/h. The plain and Zhongtan sections are wide; above Puli the Puwu Highway is a two-lane mountain road through the Renzhiguan gorge, with two rock sheds at about 74 km. Past Lushan the road ends at Tunyuan, where the Nenggao trail continues on foot; a concrete post marked 179 km survives from the plan to reach Hualien.
zh: 全线限速每小时 25 至 70 公里。平原段与中潭公路路幅较宽；埔里以上的埔雾公路为双车道山路，穿过人止关峡谷，约 74 公里处有两座明隧道。过庐山后道路止于屯原，能高越岭道由此续行，只能步行；当年规划通往花莲的“台 14 线 179K”混凝土里程桩仍留存。

why.en: No cost is published for the route as a whole, which was assembled from Japanese-era and post-war roads upgraded over decades in ordinary provincial budgets.
why.zh: 未公布全线造价。本线由日治时期与战后道路拼合而成，数十年间在一般省道预算中逐步改善。

why.en: No breakdown has been found. The provincial and later central highway budgets paid for upkeep; the 1950–53 power-line road over the Nenggao trail was paid from American aid.
why.zh: 未查到出资构成。养护由省及后来的中央公路预算支应；1950 年至 1953 年能高越岭输电线道路由美援支付。

value.en: 99.021 km since 2009; the planned through route to Renshou included 45.4 km over the range that was never built
value.zh: 2009 年起为 99.021 公里；原规划至仁寿的路线中，翻越中央山脉的 45.4 公里从未兴建

figures.source: Executive Yuan announcement 院台交字第0980072495號, 19 November 2009, and DGH route list, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 台14線

value.zh: 辖区共 58.26 亿元，其中抢修 33.07 亿元；未按路线细分

figures.source: DGH Second District Maintenance Office earthquake recovery report

value.zh: 美援 40 万美元；巡线道路 75 公里，1951 年；钢塔线路 1953 年

timeline.en: On 29 April Seediq villagers drive back a Japanese force at Renzhiguan.
timeline.zh: 4 月 29 日，赛德克族人在人止关击退日军，史称人止关之役。

timeline.en: Work begins on the Nenggao police road over the central range.
The Wushe incident, a Seediq uprising, begins on 27 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 27 日，雾社事件发生。

timeline.en: Taipower's 75 km patrol road along the Nenggao trail is finished; power flows east to west by November.
timeline.zh: 台电沿能高越岭道的 75 公里巡线道路完成，11 月木杆线路送电。

timeline.en: The Nenggao steel-tower power line is completed.
timeline.zh: 能高越钢塔输电线路完成。

timeline.en: Highway 14 is planned through to Renshou in Hualien; Wushe–Dayuling becomes 14A.
timeline.zh: 台 14 线规划延伸至花莲仁寿；雾社至大禹岭段改编为台 14 甲线。

timeline.en: The 21 September earthquake cuts the Puwu Highway; it is reopened by 29 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 21 日地震使埔雾公路中断，9 月 29 日前抢通。

timeline.en: On 19 November Lushan–Renshou is struck off; the route becomes Changhua–Lushan, 99.021 km.
timeline.zh: 11 月 19 日，庐山至仁寿段废止，路线改为彰化－庐山，全长 99.021 公里。

timeline.en: The Changshou bridge at Guoxing closes on 15 November for rebuilding.
timeline.zh: 11 月 15 日，国姓长寿桥封闭改建。
